opportunities.title: Fix the front door: tappable phone, a qualifying intake that books the free first meeting, and a claimed, correctly categorised Google profile
opportunities.problem: A prospect who decides to act cannot act. The contact page renders the phone and info@ address as plain text (0 tel: and 0 mailto: links in the DOM), so a mobile visitor must copy the number by hand; the only online route is a generic four-field box with no qualification and no booking, even though the firm advertises a free no-obligation initial meeting; and the Google profile is unclaimed and categorised 'Insurance agency' with hours set by Google. Triage also found the nav's Contact Us path returning 'Page not found' and no form anywhere, while the later DOM check found /contact serving a four-field form — the two disagree on which URL is live, but both agree there is no booking and no qualifying step.
evidence: Contact page has exactly four fields (Your Name, Your Email, Subject, Message) with a 'Send message' button, and the DOM contains no tel: or mailto: links — https://www.politziner.com/contact
Home page invites 'your call or email' and a free, no-obligation meeting, but no calendar, booking widget or qualifying questionnaire exists anywhere on the site — https://www.politziner.com/

Google profile shows 'Claim this business' (unclaimed), category 'Insurance agency', 47 Raritan Ave #2B, 'Open - Closes 9 PM', no star rating and no reviews — https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z
No JSON-LD structured data and no meta description on the home page; titles are generic ('Home | NJP Associates.') — https://www.politziner.com/
Triage browser review: at 390px the hero is a stock forest photo with the quote 'Serenity starts with a POSITIVE action' - no service statement, no CTA (review of https://www.politziner.com/)
Site runs Drupal 10 on the advisor.ws/AdvisorWebsites platform with a Webform protected by antibot, and no CRM, chat or booking tool is loaded — https://www.politziner.com/
opportunities.agent_design: A front-door build with one small agent behind it. Triggers: form submit, inbound email to info@politziner.com, missed call. Steps: replace the four-field Webform with a six-field qualified intake (goal - retirement / insurance / business succession / estate, timeline, best contact window, optional investable-asset band, consent to contact); an agent scores nothing and gives no advice, it only normalises the submission, posts it to a calendar booking page against two weekly 'free initial meeting' slots Norman actually keeps, sends an auto-acknowledgement with a short prep checklist, and notifies Ali Okoh. In parallel: claim the Google Business Profile, correct the primary category (financial planner/insurance agency per Norman's call), publish real hours and a response-time promise, and add FinancialService JSON-LD with address, phone and areaServed to the top pages. Human approves: Norman signs off the published hours, the category, the auto-acknowledgement wording (compliance-sensitive for a registered-adviser practice) and the service description before anything goes live; every booking remains a human meeting.
opportunities.why_not_DIY: The work spans three systems a subscription does not join up: a Drupal Webform on a managed vendor platform (advisor.ws/AdvisorWebsites, where template edits run through the vendor), a Google Business Profile claim with verification, and structured data on pages that currently carry no schema at all. A chatbot widget or website-builder add-on will not produce a slot on the adviser's real calendar, will not write compliance-reviewed acknowledgement copy, and does nothing about the unclaimed profile or the plain-text phone number.

impact_estimate.range: $1,400-$4,100/yr of administrative time recovered (roughly 60-180 hours/yr), plus unquantified capture of evening and on-the-go inquiries. No revenue figure is claimed.
impact_estimate.assumptions: Intake triage, reply drafting and manual scheduling today consume about 5-15 hours/month of the one named operations role (inference: there is no CRM, chat or booking tool loaded, and Ali Okoh is the only named administrative role). Hours valued at a customer-service-representative proxy of $47,740 NJ median / 2,080 = $22.95/hr. Excludes Norman's own time and any conversion uplift, because no sourced conversion benchmark for financial-adviser websites was found.

opportunities.pilot_scope: 2-3 weeks: live tel:/mailto: links; a six-field qualified intake feeding a booking calendar for the free initial meeting; auto-acknowledgement plus a document prep checklist; claimed Google profile with corrected category, published hours and a response-time promise; FinancialService JSON-LD and meta descriptions on the five main pages; a one-page handover note so Ali Okoh can change hours without a developer.

opportunities.title: Inbound-to-follow-up agent: every call, email and form becomes a logged prospect with a scheduled next step
opportunities.problem: Inquiries have no system of record. The site loads no CRM, chat or booking tool - GTM and GA4 only - so intake lands in an info@ mailbox and a phone line, and is triaged by hand by a single operations manager. Listings advertise a 9 PM close (Bing says 8 AM-9 PM Mon-Fri and Sun, Saturday closed) while the firm publishes no hours, no after-hours cover and no response-time promise, so evening and weekend inquiries most likely reach voicemail with nothing scheduled behind them. Nothing in the visible stack creates a follow-up task, so a prospect who asked about the free meeting but did not book simply stops existing.
evidence: Analytics stack is Google Tag Manager plus GA4; no chat widget, CRM embed or booking tool is loaded — https://www.politziner.com/

Bing listing advertises 8 AM-9 PM Mon-Fri and Sunday, Saturday closed, and a service list of auto, workers-comp and life insurance, while the firm's own site publishes no hours and no response-time commitment — https://www.bing.com/maps?q=NJP+Associates+47+Raritan+Ave+Highland+Park+NJ

Ali Okoh is listed as Operations Manager / Senior Branch Office Administrator, 13 years in the industry and more than nine with NJP Associates - the only named administrative role — https://www.politziner.com/team-member/ali-okoh
Referral and CPA continuing-education-credit requests are routed to the same generic /contact page rather than a dedicated request path — https://www.politziner.com/njp-difference

Client self-service is a single outbound link to the Schwab Retirement Center login on an otherwise blank page, so account questions have no in-house path — https://www.politziner.com/view-your-account
opportunities.agent_design: Event-driven intake agent with a human gate on everything that touches advice. Triggers: form submission, new mail in info@politziner.com, and a daily sweep of voicemail transcription if the phone system exposes one. The agent classifies each item (new prospect / existing client servicing / CPA CE-credit request / vendor or compliance notice), extracts the qualification fields, de-duplicates against existing records, writes a record to a light CRM the firm owns (Airtable or similar), and drafts a short reply in Norman's approved voice offering two or three concrete meeting slots. It sets follow-up nudges at +2, +7 and +21 days, sends Ali Okoh a 7am daily digest and Norman a Monday pipeline summary. Hard boundaries: no recommendations, no product or performance statements, no assertion of registration status, no account specifics - any message containing those, plus any fee question, is queued for Norman's one-click approval; account servicing questions are answered only with the Schwab link plus 'a person will call you'.
opportunities.why_not_DIY: It needs mailbox access, calendar write access, a persistent store with de-duplication, an approved-reply library and a durable audit trail of what was sent to whom - and it needs hard guardrails so a model never emits a recommendation or a credential claim on behalf of a registered representative. Off-the-shelf chatbots keep state in a thread, log nothing usable, and have no approval gate; in an SEC/FINRA-adjacent practice an unreviewed outbound sentence is a compliance event, not just a bad email.

impact_estimate.range: $830-$2,200/yr of administrative time (roughly 36-96 hours/yr) plus an unquantified reduction in lost evening and weekend inquiries.
impact_estimate.assumptions: Logging, reply drafting and reminder-chasing consume about 3-8 hours/month at a $47,740 NJ median customer-service-rep proxy ($22.95/hr). No measured response-time, no-show or lost-lead data exists for this firm, so no conversion claim is made. Directional support only from the QJE 2025 field study of a generative-AI assistant at a 5,172-agent support desk (about 15% more issues resolved per hour) - a single-task, large-firm setting: https://academic.oup.com/qje/article/140/2/889/7990658

opportunities.pilot_scope: 3-4 weeks: agent reading info@politziner.com plus the new intake form; a 12-category triage scheme; three reply templates Norman approves in week 1; shadow mode (drafts only, human sends) for weeks 1-2, then live sending for routine acknowledgements and scheduling in weeks 3-4; follow-up cadence at +2/+7/+21 days, a daily digest to Ali Okoh and a Monday pipeline summary; a weekly review of every draft sent, with a tuned reply library handed over at the end.

opportunities.title: Disclosure and document consistency agent: grounded answers from the firm's own papers, plus a scheduled diff against the regulatory record
opportunities.problem: The practice publishes an affiliation claim its own regulatory record no longer supports. The site footer says Norman Politziner is an Investment Advisor Representative of Koehler Asset Management, while the SEC/FINRA IAPD report updated 05/18/2026 states he is not currently registered as an IAR and that his last IAR registration (Kingsview Wealth Management) ended on that date. His own bio calls him 'Partner' in the heading and president in the body; the listings disagree with the practice on category, hours and services. There is no compliance staff and no mechanism checking published claims against the record, so the drift persists and nobody can say which statement is authoritative.
evidence: Footer disclosure states Norman Politziner is an Investment Advisor Representative of Koehler Asset Management and that advisory services are offered through Koehler Asset Management, an SEC-registered adviser — https://www.politziner.com/

IAPD individual report (last updated 05/18/2026): not currently registered as an Investment Adviser Representative; last IAR registration Kingsview Wealth Management 09/25/2018-05/18/2026; NJP Associates is his DBA since Dec 2002; no disclosure events — https://reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/individual/individual_711308.pdf
Bio page heading labels him 'Partner' while the body describes him as president of NJP Associates — https://www.politziner.com/team-member/norman-j-politziner

Listing data diverges from the practice: Google categorises it 'Insurance agency' with a 9 PM close, and Bing adds Saturday-closed hours and a service list of auto, workers-comp and life insurance — https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z
Publishing has stalled in a way that makes stale text likely: four blog posts all dated March 7 2024, and the 'Events' and 'FAQ' pages render only the footer — https://www.politziner.com/blog
opportunities.agent_design: A private, retrieval-based knowledge agent scoped to the firm's own corpus: all public site pages, the disclosure block, the published PDFs (the 'Wit List' process and life-insurance formula), any staff SOPs, and the IAPD record for the principal. Two jobs. (1) Answer: Ali Okoh or Norman asks 'what do we say about X / what does our process say about Y' and gets an answer with the exact page or passage cited, refusing when the corpus does not cover it. (2) Monitor: a weekly scheduled sweep diffs published claims (registration status, credentials, titles, hours, service list, category) against the IAPD record and the Google/Bing listings, and produces a ranked correction list with proposed replacement wording - delivered as a draft, never auto-published. Human approves: Norman decides every correction; anything touching the advisory relationship goes to the RIA's reviewer before it is published. The index holds no client account data, which keeps it out of the most sensitive data class.
opportunities.why_not_DIY: The value is grounding in the firm's own documents plus an external regulatory source, with passage-level citation and a rule that the agent may not assert a registration status without checking IAPD - and a scheduled diff that runs whether or not anyone remembers. A general chatbot has no private corpus, no citation trail, no schedule and no approval step, which is exactly how the current footer claim came to contradict the record. A knowledge tool also has to be able to say 'the documents do not cover this' reliably, since a confident wrong answer about credentials is the failure mode that matters here.

impact_estimate.range: 2-4 hours/month of manual cross-checking and drafting removed, at a 40-60% time reduction on those tasks (about $275-$1,100/yr), plus unquantified avoided-misstatement risk.
impact_estimate.assumptions: Hours are an inference from the visible maintenance work (a disclosure block, bios, listings and a stale blog) rather than a measured figure, since a firm this size publishes no compliance-admin time. The 40% time reduction is transferred from a peer-reviewed RCT of 453 college-educated professionals on 20-30 minute occupation-specific writing tasks (40% faster, 18% higher quality), which was simulated professional writing, not live client or compliance work: https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adh2586. Dollar value uses the $47,740 NJ median customer-service-rep proxy ($22.95/hr) because no closer clerical role benchmark was retrieved for this task mix.

opportunities.pilot_scope: 3-4 weeks: index about 20 public pages, the disclosure text and the IAPD PDF; a 25-question staff answer test scored on citation accuracy and correct refusals; one live weekly diff report; and a first correction list delivered for approval (the footer IAR claim, the president/'Partner' inconsistency, and the Google/Bing category, hours and service list), each with proposed wording and the source that contradicts it.

lead_score.rationale: Pain (20/30): strong and directly observed on the front door - plain-text phone with zero tel:/mailto: links, a four-field form with no qualification, no booking, an unclaimed Google profile on the wrong category, no schema, no meta description, and a published IAR affiliation that the 05/18/2026 IAPD record no longer supports. Docked because none of this is stated by the business itself: there are no reviews, no complaints, no client counts and no internal time data, and the internal pain is inferred from what is missing. Fit (14/20): A, C and G map cleanly onto a firm whose only visible workflow is intake, scheduling and disclosure upkeep, but the practice is one adviser plus one ops manager with no ERP, dispatch, inventory or field operations, so A's bigger workflow and D's integration work have almost nothing to attach to. Ability to pay (10/20): a 40-year fee-and-commission practice serving retirees and business owners implies a real client base (inference from positioning), but headcount is tiny, no revenue or AUM is public, and the registration lapse plus 2024-stalled content raise a genuine possibility that the advisory side is winding down - which caps what anyone should assume. Ease (12/15): single decision-maker, static Drupal site on a managed platform, small page count, standard fixes. Strategic (10/15): the intake-plus-disclosure pattern is repeatable across small advisers and insurance agencies, and the profile shows this site sits on advisor.ws/AdvisorWebsites, a managed platform used by 'thousands of financial advisors' (https://www.advisorwebsites.com/), so the same briefs and templates should port to peers - this is an inference, not a measured count. No capability E opportunity is proposed: the profile's physical signals describe a single upper-floor suite (#2B) in a desk-based advisory practice with no inventory, fleet, equipment, kitchen, dock or shop floor, and no avenues.json was supplied, so cameras or sensors would be a solution in search of a problem; for the same reason no walk-in checks are listed. The b2b-services industry brief describes staffing, engineering consulting and commercial cleaning, so only its wage proxies and its general professional-services evidence transferred; its French employment-service chatbot study is a working paper and its resume-retrieval bias study is a preprint, so neither was used as a benchmark, and the QJE call-centre result is cited only as directional because a 5,172-agent support desk is not a one-adviser office.

best_evidence_signal: Contact page publishes the phone and email as plain text (0 tel:/mailto: links) with only a four-field form and no booking, for a firm advertising a free initial meeting - https://www.politziner.com/contact
